profile.headline: Senior AI Engineer | Architecting Scalable ML & GenAI Solutions | LLMs · MLOps
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior AI Engineer with 10+ years experience. I started in data science and machine learning, moved into AI in the last few years.
Work covers ML, NLP, and RAG. Most recently, AI and automation on large-scale HCM platforms: command-driven NLP engines, rules-based decisioning, and error detection for payroll-grade systems. Payroll has to be exact.
Current work is LLM systems, RAG pipelines, and agents. Python, PyTorch, LangChain, FastAPI.

positions.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
positions.description:
I work on one HCM platform. One database. AI and automation sit on top of it.
Most of the work is IWant, the command-driven AI engine. I own the NLP layer: plain English in, employee or applicant data out. I also built the decisioning for GONE auto PTO approval from the client’s rules and error detection for Beti, the self service payroll tool. Catch the mistake before submit.
Payroll has to be exact and still feel instant. Accuracy vs latency is the hard part. That is where the time goes.
Stack is Python, PyTorch, and Hugging Face Transformers for the NLP model. Data layer is SQL and REST. Entity extraction is spaCy.
positions.insights: Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
I built the production ML service and the platform under it. Backend and infra move high-volume data through the pipeline. Models get packed into containers and served for inference at scale.
Most of the time is ML / LLM on unstructured text, and the DevOps / MLOps to make a high volume data + ML product actually scale and stay fast. That is the hard part.
Work covers platform, infra, data, MLOps, machine learning, LLMs, deploy, inference at scale, and performance tuning.
At ScienceIO the job is LLMs encoder and generative, taking messy medical text and turning it into structured insight. That is the main work.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
I built the ML models TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn. Preprocess, train, eval.
Then pack with Docker / Kubernetes and tune the pipeline on IBM Cloud so it runs in production and still scales.
positions.insights: Machine Learning, Python (Programming Language) and +7 skills

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
I built the cloud data warehouse (Redshift + S3) so finance / risk report query run faster.
Also I do the distributed process with Spark and Hive , make the ETL stable at scale when data volume is high. This is the main part.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Data Science and +4 skills

positions.insights: Data Research, Data Science and +3 skills
